Agenda
Item 1
Customer Advisory Board Feedback Summary

The committee discussed the Customer Advisory Board Feedback Summary, a review of the company's compliance with Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code. The committee confirmed that all deferred compensation plans were in compliance.

Item 2
Internal Investigation Update — Matter 105

The committee discussed the Internal Investigation Update — Matter 105, a review of the company's compliance with the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA). The committee reviewed the company's administration of its employee benefit plans and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Item 3
Approval of Prior Meeting Minutes

The committee considered the Approval of Prior Meeting Minutes, a proposal to adopt a new clawback policy for executive compensation. The policy was approved and will be included in the next proxy statement.

Motion

To defer: RESOLVED, that the Executive Bonus Plan Committee endorses the strategic framework for the Approval of Prior Meeting Minutes and directs management to develop a detailed implementation plan for review at the next meeting.

Moved: Swati Diop  •  Seconded: Rodrigo Omeje
Vote: 5 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Severance Policy Amendment — Review and Vote

The Severance Policy Amendment — Review and Vote was a review of the company's supply chain performance. Florian Murphy reported that on-time delivery rates had improved to 12%, a 105-point increase from the previous quarter.
